clipboard.description: Where y copies: auto (the terminal, via OSC 52, and the system clipboard command when there is one), osc52 (the terminal only), system (pbcopy, wl-copy, xclip, xsel or clip.exe only), off. Default auto.

max_bytes.description: Largest copy, in bytes: terminals cap what OSC 52 carries. Past it nothing is copied and the flash says so. At least 1. Default 1048576.

key_bar.description: Key bar at the bottom. Default compact.

keymap.description: Action name to keys, replacing the default keys of that action, e.g. {follow: [f, ctrl+l]}.

log_columns.description: Columns shown when a logs screen opens: pod and names of layout columns. Empty: every visible column, narrowed automatically.

paint_background.description: Paint the theme background instead of using the terminal's.

version.description: Structure version of this file; must be 1.
